subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these specific upstream GitHub Action revisions in workflows that receive GitHub App private keys or an OpenAI API key after the branch is rebased and its current-head checks complete?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but accepting new third-party action code in credentialed automation is a trust-boundary decision that cannot be settled by source diff mechanics alone.

options.title: Review and merge after validation
options.body: Verify the affected upstream action revisions and merge only after the rebased current-head workflow checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split credentialed action upgrades
options.body: Land the non-credentialed action updates separately and hold the token- or API-key-bearing action revisions for dedicated security review.

options.title: Pause this dependency batch
options.body: Close or defer the batch if the workflow-security owner does not want to adopt these upstream revisions now.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after validation
recommendation.body: Verify the affected upstream action revisions and merge only after the rebased current-head workflow checks complete successfully.

likelyOwner.person: workflow/security owner (not identified from available read-only evidence)
likelyOwner.reason: That owner is best positioned to accept the third-party action trust-boundary changes and the credential exposure model.
